arms.better: The agent found the precise append aliasing bug and implemented the correct fix, but its tm experience was costly and ended in a misleading failure: after 64 steps and repeated reads/searches, it had changed the implementation, created regression tests, and reported that `go test ./...` passed, yet `ticket.submit` errored and `tm run T-2` told the user only that something went wrong and to retry. A user would reasonably be confused why a complete, verified patch was marked failed and what retrying would do. Reduce repeated context/tool cycles and make the final-step submit path robust; when a run reaches its step limit or submit fails, report the concrete cause, preserve/show the completed work and test evidence, and give an actionable recovery rather than the generic internal-error message. Independent hidden-test verification passed after replacing the agent's tests with PR #2356's `completions_test.go`.

OpenCode stated a scoped plan, located the single problematic append quickly, copied the slice before appending, and added a regression test. It noticed that its Go test command could not run because the configured mise Go version was unavailable and said so accurately; the independent full test suite passed after hidden tests were restored. It could be better by reporting its blocked test attempt in a concise final verification summary while ensuring formatting and tests run when a usable Go toolchain is present.
